content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Spokane

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and hours of direct project leadership. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your qualifications before enrollment, ensuring you meet all prerequisites.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover all five process groups and PMBOK® fundamentals. Complete all 35 required contact hours and receive your Certificate of Completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Log into your PMI account and submit your PMP® application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to audit and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams and targeted review sessions, to build confidence. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. Sit for the computer-based exam, which tests your mastery of project-management domains and PMBOK® knowledge.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle by pursuing training, volunteering, or giving back to the project-management community. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your PMP® active and demonstrate ongoing professional growth.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
